title: Search latency regression
summary: Catalog search p95 latency tripled after the query-expansion flag was enabled for 50% of traffic.
probable_cause: A high-cardinality query pattern is saturating the search cluster.
suggested_next_action: Disable the new query expansion flag and compare p95 latency before and after rollback.
